nfl.oneThing: Jalen Hurts is expected to miss the rest of the season after doctors found blood clots in his lungs, though the Eagles say his prognosis is very good.

headlines.title: Rams injury list grows as Adams, Ford and Turner go down
headlines.summary: Davante Adams ruptured a hamstring and will miss six to 10 weeks, coach Sean McVay said. Poona Ford is out for the season with a ruptured triceps, and Kobie Turner will miss four to six weeks with a groin injury. Kicker Blake Grupe tore his ACL on a kickoff and has been placed on injured reserve, a week after the Rams signed him to replace Harrison Mevis. Myles Garrett has played just one game since his offseason trade and is on injured reserve with a knee injury.
headlines.whyItMatters: The Rams are 2–4 and Stafford is still throwing to a thinner group. Adams won't face his old team when the Rams visit the Raiders on Sunday.

headlines.title: Jalen Hurts expected to miss the season with blood clots
headlines.summary: Sources told NFL Network and ESPN that doctors found multiple blood clots in Hurts' lungs. The Eagles and his agent say he has deep vein thrombosis and bilateral pulmonary emboli, and that he is clinically stable with no significant functional limitations. Treatment with blood thinners is expected to keep the three-time Pro Bowler sidelined for at least three months. The Eagles say they expect a full recovery and that he can return to contact football once he is off the medication.
headlines.whyItMatters: Philadelphia is 2–4 and has lost four straight, so losing its starter for the rest of the year is a serious blow to a team already sliding.

headlines.title: Giants still undecided at QB after McCarthy nearly rallies
headlines.summary: Coach John Harbaugh said Monday he is 'honing in on' a decision between J.J. McCarthy and Jameis Winston for Sunday's road game against the Texans. McCarthy, who arrived in a trade from Minnesota late last month, came off the bench against the Saints with about 12 minutes left and threw for 243 yards. He led three scoring drives, but the Giants fell 34–27. Winston had 152 yards, a touchdown and two interceptions in the same game.
headlines.whyItMatters: Houston is third in the NFL with 18 sacks, so the choice matters. The Giants are 3–2–1 and the NFC's No. 4 seed.

headlines.title: Patriots lose Romeo Doubs to injured reserve
headlines.summary: Romeo Doubs landed hard on his right shoulder after a diving 42-yard touchdown catch in Sunday's 26–19 win over the Jets, and he has been placed on injured reserve. He will miss at least four games, starting Thursday night at Chicago. This season he has 14 catches for 261 yards and three touchdowns, the most receiving yards on the team. The move came the same week New England activated A.J. Brown from injured reserve.
headlines.whyItMatters: The Patriots are 4–2 and the AFC's No. 5 seed. They will be without their leading receiver in yards through at least four games.

Josh Allen threw two touchdowns, including a wild red-zone score in the third quarter that tied Jim Kelly's Bills record. The loss is Las Vegas's third straight, and it drops the Raiders to 3–3.

headlines.title: Brandon Miller signs $209M extension with Hornets
headlines.summary: Brandon Miller has agreed to a five-year, $209 million rookie-scale extension with Charlotte, reached Monday hours before the deadline for his draft class. Last season he averaged 20.2 points, 4.9 rebounds and 3.3 assists, with a career-best .574 true shooting percentage. The Hornets went 41–24 with him and 3–14 without him. He had shoulder surgery in May and has since recovered.
headlines.whyItMatters: Miller is now locked in as a cornerstone after Charlotte traded LaMelo Ball and Miles Bridges, and he steps into a bigger role this season.

headlines.title: Lakers waive Dalton Knecht and keep Bronny James
headlines.summary: The Lakers waived Dalton Knecht on Monday, bringing their roster to the 15-player limit. Bronny James and Jaden Hardy made the opening-day roster. Trade talks involving Knecht fell through, so the Lakers made a clean break. Knecht was the 17th pick in 2024 and averaged 4.2 points in about 10 minutes a game last season.
headlines.whyItMatters: The Lakers open Wednesday against Golden State with their roster set.

headlines.title: Curry's ankle scare looks minor, expected to play opener
headlines.summary: Stephen Curry rolled his right ankle in a Sunday scrimmage, but he was a full participant in practice on Monday. The Warriors expect him to play against the Lakers on Wednesday. Curry turns 39 in March and missed 27 games last season with a knee problem, so the Warriors are managing his practice load carefully.
headlines.whyItMatters: Golden State is already missing Kristaps Porzingis (undisclosed), Moses Moody (left knee surgery) and Jimmy Butler III (right knee surgery), so Curry's availability matters.

contextCard.title: How two-way contracts work
contextCard.body: Two-way contracts let an NBA team sign players who split their time between the team's NBA roster and its G League affiliate. A team can carry up to two two-way players on top of its 15-man roster. That's why several teams have been converting and waiving players this week.
